transcript_turns.speaker: bot
transcript_turns.text: Power at 540 block of Willow St may be turned off starting Friday September 11 at 6:00 PM PDT to reduce wildfire risk, and could stay off until Saturday September 12 at 8:00 PM PDT. Because this account is enrolled in the Medical Baseline program, we are calling to make sure you have received this notice. Can you confirm that you heard it?

transcript_turns.speaker: user
transcript_turns.text: Yes, I heard you. I run an oxygen concentrator at night. What am I supposed to do about that?

transcript_turns.speaker: bot
transcript_turns.text: I am not able to advise on medical equipment. A member of our team will call you back about that. The Community Resource Center at the Glen Ellen Community Hall will be open during the outage.

transcript_turns.speaker: user
transcript_turns.text: Alright, please have somebody call me.

transcript_turns.speaker: bot
transcript_turns.text: We will never ask for payment or account information on this call. Thank you.
